purpose: Define the authoritative Bundle -> Module -> Lesson -> Practice -> Tool Task -> Evidence -> Review -> Validation learning unit without deleting or rewriting existing lesson content.

learningUnit.bundle: Capability-level container and primary learner entry point.
learningUnit.module: Coherent capability section inside a bundle.
learningUnit.lesson: Existing authored learning content. Source content remains authoritative and immutable during mapping.
learningUnit.practice: Structured application activity linked to one or more lessons and skills.
learningUnit.toolTask: Practical Figma or Framer task where applicable.
learningUnit.evidence: Observable submission proving application of the target skill.
learningUnit.rework: V1-preserving improvement cycle producing V2 or later.

sourceOfTruthRules: Existing lesson content must never be deleted, silently rewritten, or replaced by generated summaries.
Every mapped lesson must retain a stable lessonId and source reference.
If a lesson cannot yet be mapped confidently, mark mappingStatus as source-gap instead of guessing.
Bundle and module structure may be additive while source lesson content remains unchanged.
Completion of a lesson is not equivalent to capability validation.
preservation: Additive implementation only until full source mapping and regression QA pass.
